task: AG-05 Targeted Safety Boundaries Negative Verification

assertions.test: Test 1: authorized_keys backup failure blocks deployment before changes
assertions.details: Removed '|| true' on backup command; verified content with cmp -s; simulated backup disk failure; production-entry.sh deploy aborted with exit 1 before candidate compose file copy or watchdog spawn; zero mutation occurred.

assertions.test: Test 2: Indeterminate SSH authorized_keys path refuses deploy
assertions.details: Configured environment with unknown remote SSH user and unresolvable sshd authorizedkeysfile; verified production-entry.sh refused to fall back or guess current user's ~/.ssh/authorized_keys; aborted with exit 1 without touching any keys.

assertions.test: Test 3: Docker inspect fail / empty / unknown strictly blocks restore
assertions.details: Defaulted container_stopped=0; tested Subcase 3a (inspect command failure), Subcase 3b (empty inspection string), and Subcase 3c (status 'unknown'); all 3 subcases engaged [SAFETY_BARRIER], strictly skipped rsync configuration overwrite and docker compose up, and exited 1.

assertions.test: Test 4: PID file points to unrelated process: zero collateral damage
assertions.details: Created unrelated background process matching Bridge command name; pointed PID file to it with mismatched configuration; tunnel-ctl orchestrated-stop and close-business verified attribution, refused to signal PID, returned exit 1, and left the unrelated process running and unharmed.

assertions.test: Test 5: watchdog.pid points to unrelated process or different deadline: refuses reuse
assertions.details: Created dummy process and configured watchdog_metadata.env with mismatched DEADLINE_EPOCH; run-resident-tunnel.sh detected deadline mismatch, refused reuse, did not signal dummy process, and spawned a fresh verified watchdog.
